'''Hangar One''' was one of the [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] in the [[Polis Massa Base (Rebel Alliance)|Polis Massa Rebel Base]]. It contained a squadron of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The hangar was built inside an abandoned tunnel about twelve [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from [[Hangar Two (Polis Massa Rebel Base)|Hangar Two]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
